title: The units stalk as an equivariant integer representation
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-pc-field-extension], $K^s=\operatorname{SeparableClosure}K$ [def-pd-separable-closure], and $\Omega$ any algebraically closed extension containing $K^s$ over $K$ in a compatible tower. Put $S=\operatorname{Spec}K$, $G=\operatorname{Gal}(K^s/K)$, and let $p$ be the geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. Suppose $E$ is an equivalence from abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] to discrete integer $G$-representations [def-exc-discrete-modules-category] equipped with a natural additive stalk identification $i$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Assume its action on germs is the lift-change formula $i(g\cdot i^{-1}(\operatorname{germ}_x z))=\operatorname{germ}_{\operatorname{Spec}(\tau)\circ x}z$ for every extension $\tau$ of $g$ to $\Omega$. Then there exists an integer-linear equivalence $e:E(\mathbf G_m)\simeq_{\mathbf Z}(K^s)^\times$, writing units additively [def-sc-gm-torsor, def-sc-galois-units-cohomology], with $e(g\cdot x)=g\cdot e(x)$ for every $g,x$. The domain has the sheaf coefficient universe $u+1$ and the codomain the field universe $u$.

proof.text: Use the proved overfield stalk-evaluation equivalence a. The component of i is an additive isomorphism; compose its additive equivalence with a and use toIntLinearEquiv to obtain the required integer-linear equivalence.

Represent i(v) by a germ using Mathlib toPresheafFiber_jointly_surjective. Extend g to an automorphism tau of Omega, construct the changed lift as an Over morphism, and apply the given lift-change action formula. Apply the evaluation formula to the two germs. GammaSpecIso_naturality and the restriction equality for tau give identical values in Omega. Injectivity of Ks -> Omega, Units.ext and Additive.toMul.injective prove equivariance.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03QV (2) and 03QW; E2: concrete overfield evaluation, residue-field refinement for injectivity, and germ-wise transport through i.
